query:
SELECT a.address AS "address!", b.balance AS "balance!"
            FROM (
                SELECT address_id, SUM(value)::bigint AS balance
                FROM tx_out
                WHERE tx_id <= $1
                  AND (consumed_by_tx_id IS NULL OR consumed_by_tx_id > $1)
                GROUP BY address_id
            ) b
            JOIN address a ON a.id = b.address_id
